no-restricted-syntax.message: Don't use raw <input>. Use <Input>, <Checkbox>, <Radio>, or <SearchInput> from @/components/ui/ instead. For file uploads, see existing FileInput patterns. If you absolutely need a raw input, add an eslint-disable comment with a reason.
Don't use raw <select>. Use <Select> from @/components/ui/Select instead.
Don't use raw <textarea>. Use <Textarea> from @/components/ui/Textarea instead.
